# Minecraft Expanded Modpack

Version **1.10.1** - 98 mods total. Built for Minecraft 1.21.1, Fabric loader 0.19.5.

## How to install

1. Go to the [latest release](../../releases/latest).
2. Under **Assets**, download **`minecraft-expanded-modpack-v1.10.1.zip`** specifically.
   **Do not** use GitHub's own "Source code (zip)" or "Source code (tar.gz)" links shown on the same page - those are auto-generated by GitHub for every release, contain none of the actual mods, and will fail to import with a "no manifest.json" / "not a CurseForge file" error.
3. Open the CurseForge app -> **Create Custom Profile** -> choose the downloaded zip file.
4. Launch. No manual mod-matching needed - everything is bundled or referenced in the zip already.
